## Highlights
### New
- On Mac, you can put the address bar on top: choose Top under Address bar in Settings › Appearance, and the address field with back, forward and reload moves above the page. - On Mac, each page in Split View carries its own bar with back, forward, its address, Site Controls and pinned extensions, wherever the address bar is.
### Improved
- On Mac, pages slide and resize into place as they join or leave Split View instead of jumping.
### Fixed
- On Mac, a folder's … button no longer covers the end of its name when you point at it. The name fades out beneath the button.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
